words.zh: 响（过去式 rang，过去分词 rung）

lines.en: When my husband was going into the dining room this morning, he dropped some coins on the floor.
lines.zh: 今天早晨我丈夫走进饭厅时，把一些硬币掉在地上了。

lines.en: We looked for them, but we could not find them all.
lines.zh: 我们虽然找了，但没能把它们全部找到。

lines.en: While we were having breakfast, our little boy, Tommy, found two small coins on the floor.
lines.zh: 正当我们吃早饭时，我们的小男孩汤米在地上找到了两枚小硬币。

lines.en: He put them both into his mouth.
lines.zh: 他把这两枚硬币全都放进了嘴里。

lines.en: We both tried to get the coins, but it was too late.
lines.zh: 我们俩都试图把这两枚硬币拿出来，但太迟了。
汤米已经把硬币咽了下去！

lines.en: Later that morning, when I was doing the housework, my husband phoned me from the office.
lines.zh: 那天上午的晚些时候，当我正做家务时，我丈夫从办公室打来电话。

lines.en: 'Tommy's been to the toilet three times this morning, but I haven't had any change yet!'
lines.zh: “今天上午汤米去了 3 次厕所了，但我还没看到硬币！”
